scope: User-authorized read-only PID-scoped CPU/RAM measurement after manual restart; no app mutation, provider requests, build, tests or restart

method.cpuBasis: 100 percent is one logical core; machine percentage divides by logical processors
method.privateMemoryBasis: Process private bytes, not resident private working set
method.workingSetCaveat: Summed working sets may double-count shared pages
method.membershipCaveat: Short-lived descendants between refreshes may be missed

summary.aggregateCorrection: Recomputed from serialized per-process CPU deltas and memory values; PowerShell Measure-Object over dynamic objects did not populate maxima/tree sums reliably.

childCpuBoundary: This sampler observed no positive descendant CPU deltas in the serialized samples; short-lived descendants can be missed between 10-second tree refreshes.
